clips.title: UPS旺季日均件量：预计环比增25%，全年指引上调后能否兑现？
title_lines: 全年指引上调后能否兑现？
title_highlights: 全年指引上调后能否兑现？

subtitles.en: Staking with UPS as chairs rally after that guidance boost, let's get straight to remain BOSIC.
subtitles.zh: UPS股价在业绩指引上调后上涨，我们直击现场，有请Remain BOSIC。

subtitles.en: Host of the close, he joins us live from UPS headquarters in Atlanta with the CEO of UPS Carol Tomay for an exclusive interview.
subtitles.zh: 《收盘》节目主持人从亚特兰大UPS总部现场连线，独家专访UPS首席执行官Carol Tomay。

subtitles.en: Thank you, Scarlett. Yes, we are here with Carol. Tomay fresh off the UPS's most recent earnings report, a Q3 number that beat on several
subtitles.zh: 谢谢，Scarlett。是的，我们和Carol在一起。Tomay刚刚结束UPS最新财报发布，第三季度多项指标超预期

subtitles.en: metrics in guidance going higher for the full year.
subtitles.zh: 并上调了全年业绩指引。

subtitles.en: There are a lot of questions right now about the sustainability of the growth, the sustainability of the turnaround that you've orchestrated.
subtitles.zh: 现在有很多关于增长可持续性、以及你所推动的转型可持续性的问题。

subtitles.en: What assurances did you give investors today that 2027 looks even better than 2026?
subtitles.zh: 你今天向市场参与者提供了什么保证，让他们相信2027年比2026年更好？

subtitles.en: Well, we'll first welcome to our headquarters here in Atlanta, Georgia, we're delighted to have you here.
subtitles.zh: 首先欢迎来到我们亚特兰大总部，很高兴你能来。

subtitles.en: And I'm super proud of the UPS team because we did report solid results today, including a return to volume growth for our SMB and enterprise customers in the United States.
subtitles.zh: 我为UPS团队感到非常自豪，因为我们今天确实公布了稳健的业绩，包括美国中小企业和大企业客户业务量恢复增长。

subtitles.en: And that gave us confidence to lift the guidance for the full year.
subtitles.zh: 这给了我们信心上调全年业绩指引。
en_highlights: lift the guidance for the full year

subtitles.en: In fact, we're heading into the busiest season of the year, which is the peak holiday season.
subtitles.zh: 事实上，我们正进入一年中最繁忙的时期，也就是假日旺季。

subtitles.en: And based on forecasts that we received from our customers, we expect our volume, our average daily volume to increase about 25% from the third quarter to the fourth quarter.
subtitles.zh: 根据客户提供的预测，我们预计第四季度的日均业务量将比第三季度增长约25%。

subtitles.en: So given the underlying strength of the business, we were delighted to raise both our revenue and our profit guidance for the year.
subtitles.zh: 鉴于业务的基本面强劲，我们很高兴上调了全年的营收和利润指引。
en_highlights: raise both our revenue and our profit guidance

entities.evidence: UPS official Simplified Chinese leadership page and UPS investor relations page confirm the company identity; UPS is the standard short form in Chinese financial media.

UPS official Simplified Chinese leadership page gives 凯萝·多梅 (Carol B. Tomé) as CEO; the common media transliteration 卡罗尔·托梅 appears in Chinese coverage but was not confirmed by a second independent snippet here.
Two public profiles place UPS CEO and headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia; 亚特兰大 is the established Simplified Chinese name.
UPS earnings materials use SMB for small and medium-sized businesses; 中小企业 is the standard Chinese rendering.

clip_research.source_claim: UPS reported solid Q3 results including a return to volume growth for U.S. SMB and enterprise customers, giving confidence to lift full-year guidance.
clip_research.public_baseline: UPS's official 3Q 2025 release reports consolidated revenue of $21.4 billion and operating profit of $1.8 billion ($2.1 billion adjusted), and provides fourth-quarter 2025 guidance plus full-year capital allocation expectations.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript frames the guidance raise as a confidence signal, while the official release emphasizes Q4 guidance and cost reduction; the specific 25% peak-season volume increase in the current title is not confirmed by the snippets.

evidence.fact: CEO says Q3 beat on several metrics and full-year guidance was raised.
CEO cites return to volume growth for U.S. SMB and enterprise customers.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
